objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-appx-deployment-package-installation-success
objects.description: This analytic detects successful MSIX/AppX package installations on Windows systems by monitoring EventID 854 in the Microsoft-Windows-AppXDeployment-Server/Operational log. This event is generated when an MSIX/AppX package has been successfully installed on a system.
